summary.text: Murri Briel, listed by Ballotpedia as Amy Murri Briel, is a Democratic member of the Illinois House of Representatives from District 76, in office since January 2025, and she is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She previously served as chief of staff to her predecessor, Lance Yednock.

paragraphs.text: Amy Murri Briel attended Illinois State University.
Her career experience includes serving as chief of staff for former state representative Lance Yednock (D) and as a caseworker for domestic violence and sexual assault survivors.
Briel assumed office in the Illinois House on January 8, 2025, succeeding Yednock, and advanced from the Democratic primary on March 17, 2026.

For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists her on the Agriculture & Conservation, Appropriations-Higher Education, Counties & Townships, Energy & Environment, House Human Services, Transportation: Regulation, Roads & Bridges, and Veterans' Affairs committees.
Ballotpedia lists Liz Bishop (R) as the other candidate on the general election ballot.
